intro: One medium pack of fries is an estimated 340 kcal. Most of the calories come from the potato itself and the frying oil.
diet: Yes, but fries are easy to overeat because they're tasty and don't keep you full long. A medium size is already close to more than a cup of rice. If you want some, get a small or share. Make sure there's protein in the same meal.
tips: Pick small, or share a medium.
Don't upsize your set, even if it's just a bit extra.
Eat your burger or chicken first, then the fries, so you're less likely to overeat.

swap.name: Small corn cup
swap.why: Still carbs and filling, but not fried. Saves over 200 kcal.

faq.a: Air fryers use less oil, so the fat is lower. The texture is a bit different but still crispy.

faq.q: Why are fast food fries so crispy?
faq.a: They're usually fried twice and lightly coated with a bit of flour or sugar. That keeps them crispy.
Yes, use an air fryer or a dry pan for a few minutes. Avoid the microwave.
